name: testimonial-basic

frames.best_why: The heading, the full first video row with quote and five stars, and the start of the next row are visible.

tagline: Big video stills beside long five-star customer quotes.
summary: A white editorial page stacked with review rows. Each row pairs a wide video thumbnail with a play badge and timecode next to a rounded avatar, bold name, monospaced role, an oversized quotation and five gold stars.
appearance: White page framed by thin grey rules, with a small spaced "« TESTIMONIALS »" label and a very large black uppercase title. Rows pair a landscape video still with a white play button and timecode against a rounded avatar, heavy name, mono role, large quote and five gold stars.
behaviour: The rows stack down the page and scroll normally. Hovering a video still nudges the photo slightly larger and grows the play badge; nothing else moves and no video plays.
demo_content: Heading "SOCIAL PROOF." with reviews from Beverley, Marcus Aurelius and Sarah Jenkins and fake clips.
search_phrases: quote and video side by side
use_when: A coaching, course or SaaS page wants rich proof rows that pair a video still with a long quote and a rating.
avoid_when: The play buttons are decorative and start nothing, and all three reviews with their media are hardcoded.
customise: The three reviews, quotes, ratings, avatars and video stills are hardcoded; the stripe texture and column widths need source edits.
weight_why: Static photos and text with CSS hover scales; nothing animates on its own.

a11y.note: Play badges are spans inside a clickable-looking row with no action or keyboard reach, and alt text for the stills is generic.

issues: Rows never alternate sides: the direction class does not reorder the grid, so every video stays left.
Play buttons and timecodes suggest playback that the component never provides.
The diagonal stripe texture is barely visible on the white panels.
polish_why: Crisp editorial type and consistent rows; dead play buttons and the broken alternation hurt it.
title: Testimonial Basic
